name: ethionamide to sulfate
summary: A 7-step route from ethionamide to sulfate, ingested from Rhea. Every step is curated by Rhea and independently verified here to balance in mass and charge.

reactions.name: ethionamide + NADPH + O2 + H(+) = ethionamide S-oxide + NADP(+) + H2O
reactions.equation: ethionamide + NADPH + O2 + H(+) = ethionamide S-oxide + NADP(+) + H2O

reactions.name: sulfite dehydrogenase (cytochrome)
reactions.equation: 2 Fe(III)-[cytochrome c] + sulfite + H2O = 2 Fe(II)-[cytochrome c] + sulfate + 2 H(+)
